scope: Qwen3.5-2B/4B TP1, 10 projection N/K pairs, 12 batches through 32; kernel-only microbenchmarks, not end-to-end inference
method: Repository benchmark_mxfp8.py + gemm_bench.py bench_kineto; one GEMM per CUDA Graph; 8 GB L2 eviction before EVERY replay, excluded from measurement; 3 cyclic/interleaved trials of 30 kernel durations, median of trial means. FlashInfer exact-batch autotuning. No hot-cache timings in this artifact.
reference: Original interval-dispatch configurations measured interleaved on the SAME GPU using unchanged legacy kernels in the same final library; explicit reference_config retained per point.

cutlass.note: Pre-existing local CUTLASS changes retained; no additional CUTLASS modification for this kernel.

validation.independent_oracle: All 320 model N/K x integer M1..32 cases; FP32 independently dequantized matmul, relative RMSE < 0.004.
